`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options, and `updateLandscape` still works. The `cli` module compiles. I did not run `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` or either `-help` output, and I didn't add a test.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` (`"analyzeLandscape"`) and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The command is also in the no-argument usage overview, using the same landscape options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names go to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name you typed (`analyzeLandscape` or `updateLandscape`).
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line" section. It lists `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape` and `updateConfig`. It notes that `updateLandscape` is the older name and is still supported.

I didn't commit anything.
